page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It also does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Hardware-level acceleration features, such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA), are not exposed or supported on this instance type.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low memory-to-core ratio of 1:1, the ecs.s3.medium is structured as a budget-friendly option for compute-centric workloads that do not require large memory footprints or advanced instruction sets. Suitable workloads include lightweight batch processing, basic web serving, utility scripting, and development or testing environments that benefit from dedicated CPU execution without the overhead of high memory capacity.
